description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for spatial data processing in a mapping/charting context, including handling different spatial data formats, building queries, and processing spatial records.

methods.name: getSpatialColumns
methods.description: Determines the relevant spatial columns based on the spatial configuration type.

methods.name: addSpatialNullFilters
methods.description: Adds IS NOT NULL filters for spatial columns to ensure data completeness.

methods.name: buildSpatialQuery
methods.description: Constructs a query context for spatial data based on form data.

methods.name: parseCoordinates
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated latitude and longitude string into a coordinate tuple.

methods.name: reverseGeohashDecode
methods.description: Decodes a geohash string into latitude and longitude coordinates.

methods.name: addJsColumnsToExtraProps
methods.description: Adds specified JavaScript columns to the feature's extraProps.

methods.name: processSpatialData
methods.description: Processes raw records into spatial points with positions, weights, and extra properties.

methods.name: getMapboxApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Mapbox API key from parameters or bootstrap data.

methods.name: transformSpatialProps
methods.description: Transforms chart properties into spatial features and configuration for rendering.
